label: recheck-a
tail:
Re-check complete. All four of my pairs flipped to `sufficient`; the closure gate now shows my group clean (the two remaining `scaffold-insufficient` errors are group `b`'s, batches 5 and 10).

**Batches 6, 7, 8 — every finding verified from disk, and the source-fidelity ones re-verified against the live sources rather than the notes that reported them.**

- **B6-1 confirmed.** Corral's Corollary 4.18 re-fetched verbatim ("The flux of the curl of a smooth vector field f(x,y,z) through any closed surface is zero"); the row now carries that wording and `cor-the-flux-of-a-curl-through-the-boundary-of-a-glued-elementary-solid-vanishes` sits at position 33, A page at 45 items, all deps at earlier positions or published, contract entry with substantive (not templated) boundary rows, three published quotes verbatim on disk. The title narrows Corral's "any closed surface" to what the route delivers — correct, not an overclaim.
- **B6-2 confirmed**, CLP-4 Lemma 4.1.13 re-fetched and the parenthetical is faithful; all thirteen named §4.1 results now carry a row.
- **B6-3 confirmed on four rows, push-back accepted on the fifth.** I opened `lem-cross-product-is-bilinear-alternating-and-orthogonal`: it states bilinearity, alternating, the determinant identity and orthogonality — the vector triple product expansion is not there and is on no item in the corpus. `already-published` would have been exactly the inaccurate citation B6-1 was about.
- **B7-1 confirmed** by re-derivation: 233 citations over 60 entries all match `^[FAL]\d+$`, no in-entry duplicates, every derivation input resolves.
- **B7-2 confirmed in substance.** Tao Ex. 1.6.8 (p. 140) and Ex. 1.6.25 (p. 153) read out of the PDF verbatim; arXiv:2505.00556 Thm 1.1 and Cor 1.2 verbatim from the HTML. I enumerated Tao §§1.6.1–1.6.2 independently — the only numbered item absent from the harvest is Ex. 1.6.28, which is in §1.6.3 outside the locator. **One sentence of the notes is false of disk:** "the Wikipedia row now backs no item" — two Wikipedia rows still name the Steinhaus theorem and the subgroup corollary. Not a blocker (the rows are true of the source and the items no longer rest on Wikipedia alone), but recorded so step 5 does not put the encyclopedia entry in `sources.references`.
- **B7-3 confirmed on seven, push-back accepted.** The published items give compact+compact and closed-at-distance-zero; the compact-plus-closed statement is on neither and nowhere in the corpus.
- **B7-4 confirmed**, and all three neighbours now declare countable choice consistently.
- **B8-1–B8-4 confirmed**; my own step-3 repair survives intact (zero surviving deps edges, contract facts F1–F7, all 81 entries grammar-clean).

**One repair of my own:** batch 7's Tao locator claimed §§1.6.1–1.6.2 complete but gave printed pp. 137–155; §1.6.1 starts at p. 136 and Ex. 1.6.5 on that page *is* harvested, so the locator did not contain its own rows. Corrected to pp. 136–155 (PDF 152–171), Ex. 1.6.5 through Ex. 1.6.27; gate re-run clean.

Gates: `coverage-checklist --require-destination` 6/7/8 clean, `content-policy --manifest-only` 796 items 0 errors, `validate-plan` pass, `url-sweep --recover --fail-on-dead` 14/14 live, `source-fetch-check` 5/5, `boundary-audit` no contradictions.

Two scope denials carried to step 9 with named destinations (CLP-4 Lemma 4.1.8.b, Tao Ex. 1.2.4) — each a real statement whose natural home is already published, so an owner decision rather than a page to invent.
